purpose: Quality-first validation of English v6; no mandatory Chinese/English A/B experiment.
replication: One first-valid result for 36 trajectories; one additional independent call for 8 selected trajectories.
retry_rule: Only transport/schema failures; never choose best-of valid labels; retain every attempt.
model_snapshot_policy: Record resolved model/version if available; an alias may change over time.
source_payload_rule: Pass only the pinned prepared input JSON; never include selection metadata, old judgments, official outcomes, or reference labels.
fallback_policy: Review concrete English-v6 errors against Chinese v6 and v5; use English v5 only if evidence favors its rules. Do not infer a better prompt without pilot evidence.
